parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Floyd Home Team,

We believe a collaborative Instagram post with a popular home decor influencer could significantly expand your brand reach. By showcasing your products in a real-life setting, influencers can reach a wider audience and demonstrate the comfort and style of your furniture and bedding. This approach not only enhances your brand's visibility but also provides valuable social proof for your customers.

We propose working together to create a post that highlights the unique features and benefits of Floyd Home products in a visually appealing and engaging way.

Looking forward to discussing this opportunity further.
